metadata.title: Real-Time Messaging

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enabling ad-hoc, live communication while preserving identity clarity, boundary control, and accountability.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Voice and video calling, huddles, live chat overlays, real-time reactions, and transient synchronous communication features.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing identity, access, and behavior in ad-hoc real-time communication contexts.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Real-time messaging trust depends on baseline collaboration identity, boundary, and accountability guarantees.

metadata.remarks: Real-Time Messaging defines trust properties for ad-hoc, live communication that is neither asynchronous chat nor scheduled conferencing. This pattern addresses rapid escalation risks, authority confusion, and unrecorded interaction without prescribing recording or conferencing semantics.

components.title: Real-Time Session Identity and Attribution
components.description: Ensures all real-time participants are authenticated and accurately attributed during live communication.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through misleading identity presentation in live sessions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to misrepresent authority in real-time interactions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding to live communication sessions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Participants in real-time sessions are authenticated.
Identity attributes support reliable attribution during live communication.

components.title: Real-Time Boundary and Escalation Control
components.description: Constrains opportunistic escalation from chat to live communication without appropriate boundaries.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Social engineering via rapid escalation to live communication.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-based restriction of real-time initiation and escalation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Real-time messaging initiation and escalation follow least privilege.
Policies define appropriate use and escalation paths for live communication.

components.title: Transience and Recording Awareness
components.description: Ensures participants understand the transient or recorded nature of real-time communication.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or misuse of live communication content.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Clear signaling of recording or non-recording conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define when real-time communication may be recorded.

components.title: Real-Time Messaging Observability and Accountability
components.description: Provides oversight into initiation, participation, and termination of real-time communication.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to misuse of live communication.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and review to ensure accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Real-time messaging events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports investigation of real-time misuse.
